newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares steam ahead, Forekspank in focus.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares steam ahead, Forekspank in focus.

text.p: Estonian shares steamed ahead on Monday, fuelled by big gains in fifth largest bank Forekspank and drug maker Tallinna Pharmaceutical, dealers said.
Forekspank climbed 10 kroons after it announced a November profit of 5.6 million kroons, dealers said.
The overall main list volume reached 24.9 million kroons and the market index added 2.49 percent to 137.84.
"We had good news on Forekspank after a long time," said one dealer. Forekspank turned over more than nine million kroons and closed at 94.25 versus 84.25 on Friday.
Estonian drug firm Tallinn Pharmaceutical also helped push the market higher.
It turned over 2.3 million kroons and closed at 87.75 kroons versus 79.50.
Dealers said that the results published last week by the company were still being reflected in the price rise.
Union bank was also well-traded as shares worth 4.1 million kroons changed hands and it closed at 26.30 kroons versus 25.60.
Market leader Hansapank showed trade of some three million kroons and closed slightly higher at 136.50 kroons.
The over-the-counter market had volume of 3.9 million kroons and the Rakvere meat processor was the most active with trade of 2.6 million kroons. It closed higher at 7.45 kroons versus 6.90.
